title: Dinner Lady Black Orange Crush Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Part of Dinner Lady’s Ice range, Black Orange Crush is a delicious fusion of sweet and tart blackcurrants and juicy oranges, with a beguiling layer of crushed ice for a mouth-watering, refreshing all-day vape. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
